name: Screaming Lord Sutch
description:
'''Screaming Lord Sutch''' (born '''David Edward Sutch''', 10 November 1940 – 16 June 1999) was an English musician and [[Perennial candidate|perennial parliamentary candidate]].

He was the founder of the [[Official Monster Raving Loony Party]] and served as its leader from 1983 to 1999, during which time he [[perennial candidate|stood in numerous parliamentary elections]]. He holds the record for contesting the most Parliamentary elections: 39 between 1963 and 1997. As a singer, he variously worked with [[Keith Moon]], [[Jeff Beck]], [[Jimmy Page]], [[Ritchie Blackmore]], [[Charlie Watts]], [[John Bonham]], [[Noel Redding]], [[Mitch Mitchell]] and [[Nicky Hopkins]], and is known for his recordings with [[Joe Meek]] including "[[Jack the Ripper (song)|Jack the Ripper]]" (1963).
